name: MANCI
description: MANCI is the company token of Mancipatio d.o.o. Beograd (Serbia), issued on the Manci platform by Mladen Rakić from his stake in the company. 1 token = 0.01 % of the company; 10,000 tokens = 100 %; at most 1,750 tokens (17.5 %) can be issued. Each token is a documented right to acquire that share: conversion into registered company shares requires identity verification. Rights: voting, dividend, transferable.
